ownerReview.review: KJV remaining New Testament complete-context review

edits.expected: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
edits.replacement: Which have borne witness of thy love before the church: whom if thou help along on their journey in a manner worthy of God, thou shalt do well:
edits.reason: Support travel hospitably, not bring forward their departure date. Keeps how this honors God and the prior love repair.

edits.reason: Preeminence is first place sought over others, not a new ecclesiastical office; refusal to receive apostolic message remains.

edits.expected: I will remember his deeds which he doeth,
edits.replacement: I will call attention to his deeds:
edits.reason: Remember here means bring up deeds publicly on the proposed visit. Colon introduces explicit he, avoiding a dangling participle that might attribute malicious talk to the letter writer.

edits.expected: prating against us with malicious words:
edits.replacement: he talks nonsense against us with malicious words;
edits.reason: Explicit he assigns prating/malicious talk to Diotrephes. Semicolon connects subsequent refusal and expulsion; conditional visit and every deed retained.
